why: Multiple uncredited preprint 'proof' claims appeared in 2025-2026 (e.g. researchgate, preprints.org, academia.edu) but none have been accepted or verified by the mathematical community; no credible source reports resolution or a counterexample. Computational verification limit remains near 4x10^18 with no reported extension, and that would not count as progress on the conjecture itself in any case.
